summary: Iteration 2 testing complete — all new features verified end-to-end. Backend: 23 passed / 2 admin-gated skipped (25 total). New AI assistant (Claude Sonnet 4.5) endpoints work: new session returns reply, multi-turn memory verified ($87,500 declared in turn 1 was correctly recalled in turn 2 reply), history persisted in MongoDB with role/content/ts shape, empty message rejected with 422. PWA assets all serve 200: /manifest.json (valid: name, short_name, start_url, display=standalone, theme_color, 192/512 icons), /service-worker.js, /favicon.ico, /og-image.jpg, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /offline.html. Frontend: title is 'TMF Line — Strategic Business Funding…' (not Emergent template), no #emergent-badge element and no 'Made with Emergent' text in DOM, OG og:title/og:image/og:description present, manifest+favicon links present, navigator.serviceWorker registered with controller, chat-toggle visible on all 7 routes (/, /mca, /heloc-calculator, /long-term-loans, /funding-estimator, /about, /contact), suggestion chip click → loading indicator → assistant reply (956 chars), Enter-to-send works, session persisted in localStorage and 4 messages reloaded after page refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html still loads <script src='https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js'> — the runtime DOM check confirmed it does NOT inject any visible #emergent-badge or 'Made with Emergent' text on this build, so user-facing requirement is satisfied. However, removing the script tag entirely would eliminate any future re-introduction risk and a third-party network call.

ChatAssistant.jsx getSessionId() touches localStorage at module evaluation time (useState initializer). This is fine in a browser but will throw during SSR if the app is ever rendered server-side; consider guarding with `typeof window !== 'undefined'`.

server.py assistant_chat passes prior conversation as a manual primer string in addition to relying on session_id. The comment says auto-history would 'double-bill tokens' — verify that LlmChat with the same session_id is not internally also persisting/replaying, otherwise context is being sent twice.

service-worker.js registration uses default scope ('/') and is triggered on every page load — confirmed registered (1 registration, controller present). No revisioning/cache-bust strategy visible; document/version the SW cache name to avoid stale-bundle issues on deploys.

Pre-existing carryover from iter1: /api/leads still has no ADMIN_SECRET in /app/backend/.env — endpoint correctly returns 401 to all callers, so PII is no longer leaked, but admin listing is also unusable until secret is configured.
